title: PowerPoint: edit presentations with Copilot in GCC High
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and the conflicting service-description availability, and its licence-assignment path and PowerShell command are documented. Minor corrections are needed for a checklist step missing from the controls table and an uncited source supporting licence-removal roles.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout, At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses is the licence-assignment route.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense with UserId, AddLicenses containing SkuId, and empty RemoveLicenses assigns a product licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: License Administrator is a supported role for assigning licences.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: User Administrator is a supported role for assigning licences.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: License Administrator is a supported role for unassigning licences.
claims.quote: Add or remove licenses for the user to enable or disable their use of Microsoft cloud offerings. The following least privileged roles are supported for this operation: Directory Writers; License Administrator; User Administrator.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/user-assignlicense?view=graph-rest-1.0 to sources as 'user: assignLicense'; it explicitly supports both named licence-removal roles.

claims.claim: User Administrator is a supported role for unassigning licences.
claims.quote: Add or remove licenses for the user to enable or disable their use of Microsoft cloud offerings. The following least privileged roles are supported for this operation: Directory Writers; License Administrator; User Administrator.

claims.claim: Teams & groups > Active teams & groups lets administrators inspect members of groups receiving group-based licences.
claims.quote: To see which users are receiving the license through that group, go to the Teams & groups > Active teams & groups page to view its members.

claims.claim: Administrators can unassign licences by selecting the product, checking users or groups and selecting Unassign licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. Select the check boxes of the users or groups for whom you want to unassign licenses. Select Unassign licenses.

claims.claim: No separate tenant switch specific to this PowerPoint editing capability was found in Microsoft Learn.
claims.quote: Searched: Manage Copilot PowerPoint editing Office cloud policy tenant setting; "PowerPoint" "Edit with Copilot" "policy" disable. Opened configure-copilot-admin-center and service description in full; neither documents a separate switch for this capability.
